profile.headline: Custom Software Engineer Senior Analyst @ Accenture Federal Services | Data Analysis, Leadership, Accountability
profile.summary:
With over four years of experience in software engineering roles at Accenture Federal Services, I specialize in converting management ideas into efficient software solutions. My work focuses on developing, testing, and debugging applications using programming languages such as Java, Scala, and JavaScript. These efforts help ensure operational reliability and meet organizational needs.  

As an ICAgile Certified Professional and Full Stack Java Developer, I am dedicated to creating and enhancing software that drives performance and functionality. I am passionate about collaborating with teams to design solutions, address client concerns, and maintain high standards in software development.

positions.title: Custom Software Engineer Senior Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Accountability · Core Java · English · Angular5 · HTML · Leadership · Maven · Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) · Presentation Skills · RESTful WebServices · React.js · SQL · Spring MVC · Team Building · XML · Data Analysis · Team Leadership · Skilled Multi-tasker · Customer Service

positions.title: Custom Software Engineer Analyst
positions.description:
Convert management ideas and designs into computer code as well as test the code to ensure that it produces the expected results

Write software applications in a variety of computer languages, such as Java, Scala, Java Script  Programming

Update and enhance existing software applications

Debug software applications by testing for and fixing errors

Manages the day-to-day operations of software applications by monitoring performance, configuration, maintenance, and repair

Applies revisions to software applications.

Develops new software applications implementation plans, custom scripts, and testing procedures to ensure operational reliability.

Train staff in proper use of new software developed and/or acquired.

Ensures high availability and acceptable levels of performance of mission critical software applications

Stays current with technological developments in systems support technology and recommends ways for clients to take advantage of new technology.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Analyze the needs of the user
• Design, test and develop the software to meet those needs
• Recommend upgrades for existing systems and programs
• Develop separate elements of a software that work well in the program as a whole
• Create various diagrams, flowcharts and models that illustrate the type of code needed for programmers
• Ensure continued functionality of a program during maintenance and testing of software
• Document each aspect of a system or application as a reference for future upgrades and maintenance
• Revisit the development process to fix bugs or address client or consumer concerns

positions.title: Mail Carrier
positions.locationName: St. Louis City County, Missouri, United States
positions.description:
Delivers letters, documents, and parcels to businesses and homes.

Travels planned routes on foot or by truck.

Collects outgoing mail along route, and when necessary, collects money for postage due.

Sorts mail, including packages, according to delivery sequence.

Loads sacks and boxes filled with mail onto and off mail truck.

Maintains logs to monitor delivery rates and vehicle maintenance scheduling.

Obtains signatures on registered, insured, and certified mail.

Sells stamps, money orders, and other postal products to customers along route, particularly on rural routes.

Communicates with dispatcher and modifies route according to instructions when needed.

Answers questions about USPS or company policies from customers along routes.

Provides change-of-address cards and other postal forms.

Operates postal equipment

positions.title: Installation Technician
positions.description:
Traveling to customers' homes or place of business.

Installing electrical or computer equipment such as flat-screen televisions, projectors, routers, desktop computers, laptops, and tablets.

Suggesting areas where equipment should be set up and where cords should be placed.

Troubleshooting problems with existing equipment.

Testing old and new installation connections.

Providing customers with verbal and written operating instructions for new equipment.

Maintaining equipment.

Cleaning up after the job is complete.

Recording and maintaining stock levels.

Maintaining the work vehicle

positions.title: Aviation Electronic Technician
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
As an Aviation Electronics Technician (AT), you’ll maintain, troubleshoot, repair and test complex electronic systems related to aviation on fixed wing aircraft. In this role, I work with systems including digital computers, fiber optics, infrared detection, radar, laser electronics, navigation, pressure indication, and electrical power generation and distribution. Additional responsibilities may include:

Installing modifications to aircraft electronic systems

Performing micro-miniature module repair on computer circuit cards

Performing electrical diagnostics

Reading electrical system diagrams

Repairing and maintaining power generators and electric motors

Performing scheduled maintenance and corrosion control
